phase: 2A.1 — Linguistic Integrity Recovery, Attestation & Gold-Readiness Gate
summary: Phase 2A.1 has successfully resolved core linguistic bugs (howa conjugation, phela vector restrictions with cognitive achievements, -ni negation morphology, feature-sensitive DOM, and particle disambiguation). Automated test suites pass with exact assertions. The repository is architecturally and linguistically sound for human-curated Gold seed generation, but NO automated mass generation may occur without expert human review of the diagnostic queue.

source_grounding.notes: 12 registered primary sources with claim-level evidence and frozen bibliographies.

morphotactics_and_inflections.notes: Dedicated paradigms for howa, regular closed roots, vowel-mutating roots, and irregular verbs. Verified lexicon of 25+ conjunctive participles.

complex_predicates.notes: Feature-based vector verb selection allows cognitive achievements with phela while rejecting pure statives; 8 polysemous vector specifications formalized.

dom_and_case_marking.notes: Feature-sensitive DOM engine evaluates animacy, definiteness, specificity, and classifiers to assign overt -ke vs bare -Ø.

negation_and_polarity.notes: Morphologically accurate perfective negation (-ni) and general post-verbal sentential negator (na).

pragmatic_particles_and_disambiguation.notes: Context-sensitive and valency-based ki disambiguation; polyfunctional senses modeled for i, o, to, na, je, ba, ki.

corpus_attestation_coverage.notes: 12 empirical corpus attestations linking grammar literature, research corpora, and contemporary texts to rules and frames under research fair-use handling.

diagnostic_review_queue.notes: 156 curated diagnostic review items prepared across 11 linguistic categories in data/review_queue/ marked PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW.

verification_test_suite.notes: 75 unit and regression tests passing with exact output assertions and adversarial rejection tests.

prerequisites_for_phase_3_scaling: Expert human linguist sign-off on high-uncertainty items in data/review_queue/linguistic_review_pack.json.
No automated process may assign HUMAN_APPROVED.
Phase 3 dataset collection must strictly operate under Gold curation protocols with dual-annotator inter-rater agreement.
